frontend: Frozen B24+midpoint sigma1.5/epoch03; original M always delivered
identity: ReDC-inspired project size judgement, not original ReDC CR/DDE/CAR reproduction
sources: Frozen P3 sampled at each judged box; aligned9x9 with1.5 context, channel-major3x3 pooling2304; original and contrast arms share input
variants: TRAIN only: raw long/short/both times .85,.95,1.05,1.15; preserve center/raw angle/score, skip axis inversion; never GT-conditioned generation
transform: Fit centered PCA256 and normalizer only on original full TRAIN M; one shared transform for both arms and all variants; no whitening
objective: Original: full TRAIN balanced BCE. Contrast: same real objective + .25 unweighted auxiliary BCE, mean per valid variant then per image. GT offline labels only, max canonical relative edge error>.10.
capacity: 259 features; separate raw score logit;258->16->8->1 ReLU+beta4290; exact neutral -z, same seed1701 hidden initialization
budget: 100 epochs,1000 updates per arm,256 genuine images per batch; seed1701 identical order. Auxiliary samples add compute, not new scenes. No checkpoint or coefficient search
precheck: Discard two smoke steps; actual separate real/weighted auxiliary gradient norms, strength ratio, sum gradient and pre/post clipping recorded; hidden gradient expected only after neutral output is updated
roles: Full original TRAIN -> full original VAL and one global threshold -> frozen exposed TEST reporting only after pass. No fit/probe/other new roles
threshold: Minimum one global whole-tie VAL cutoff for >=95% correct retention in every domain/video; old policy preserved separately
gate: Only contrast may advance: strict overall same-count and same-CR FA gain over retrained original/full_simple/score, group FA nonincrease and longest correct-FR same-CR nonincrease; conservative ties. Failure stops
safety: No box/score/count/missing/center/angle edits, no depth changes, no GT/domain/video online inputs. VAL has no synthetic boxes. TEST never selection; repeatedly exposed
review: Raw feature bytes, independent candidate regeneration/labels, original-only PCA/normalization, NumPy logits, full states/coverage/ranking, matched counts and CR, threshold/budget/initialization and frozen input hashes
